2610.13695.title: Verifiable Retrieval for Legal Reasoning through Structure-driven Knowledge Graph
2610.13695.paper_summary: Any automation within reliability-critical contexts such as medicine or law has to be transparent and verifiable. Despite their advantages, current LLM-based systems do not meet these requirements due to their inherent black-box nature. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) attempts to ground the generative process in the relevant interpretable documents, thereby reducing the risk of AI 'hallucinations' and potentially enabling verification of the initial generation context. However, as the number and size of potential sources increases, naive retrieval approaches tend to perform worse, ignoring critical context elements. In this paper we aim to tackle this problem in the context of German Legal Code. Using structure-driven parsing to create a Knowledge Graph (KG) for the source document navigation and retrieval, we compare several KG-informed chunking and retrieval strategies and evaluate their effect on the accuracy of retrieved citations.
2610.13695.paper_summary_zh: 任何在可靠性關鍵的領域，如醫學或法律中的自動化，都必須是透明且可驗證的。儘管當前的 LLM 基於系統具有其優勢，但由於其固有的黑箱特性，並不符合這些要求。檢索增強生成（RAG）試圖將生成過程基於相關的可解釋文件，從而降低 AI "幻覺" 的風險，並可能實現對初始生成上下文的驗證。然而，隨著潛在來源的數量和大小增加，天真的檢索方法往往表現更差，忽略了關鍵的上下文元素。在本文中，我們旨在解決這一問題，並將其置於德國法律法典的背景下。通過結構驅動的解析來創建一個知識圖譜（KG）以進行源文件的導航和檢索，我們比較了幾種基於 KG 的分塊和檢索策略，並評估它們對檢索引用準確性的影響。
2610.13695.author: Ibrahim Siddig et.al.
